title: Labels wrap at Mermaid's wrapping width, scaled to the drawn font size

v:
Siren drew every label on one line, so long-labelled nodes became very wide: in the garden-network diagram Tasks was 570×32 in Siren and 260×102 in Mermaid, which stretched the whole picture. Mermaid 11.17.2 (measured in headless Chrome) lays an HTML label out on one line first; once its text reaches 200px it gets `width: 200px; white-space: break-spaces` and the browser breaks it (`labelHelper`, chunk-4HAMMTFA.mjs:169-177; `createText` defaults to 200 for edge labels). That `
` holds the text only; the shape's padding sits outside it. Mermaid's text is 16px. Siren draws SVG ``, so it has no browser line-breaking to borrow and wraps labels itself. Board plan: `.scratch/flowchart-mermaid-parity-2/spec.md`. ## The rules 1. Wrap width = 200 × (the label's drawn font size in px) / 16: 175 for flowchart nodes (14px), 150 for connector labels (12px). It comes from `wrapWidthAt` in `label/label.ts`. 2. The wrap width bounds the text only; the measurer's padding is outside it, as Mermaid's shape padding is outside its label `
`. A label wraps only if some row's text is wider than the wrap width. Once it wraps, its box is the wrap width plus the measurer's padding (Mermaid's fixed 200px `
`); otherwise it is measured as before. 3. Break opportunities: after spaces (dropped at the break), and between any two characters where either is CJK (Han, kana, Hangul, CJK punctuation, full-width forms). No line begins with `，。、；：？！」』）】》,.;:?!)]}`. Lines are filled greedily; this is not UAX #14. 4. An unbreakable piece wider than the wrap width is not cut: it overflows and the box takes the widest row. 5. `
` and other forced breaks are kept; each written row wraps on its own. Run styles carry across breaks. 6. Wraps: flowchart nodes and edge labels, state descriptions and transition labels, class relationship labels, ER relationship labels. Never wraps: subgraph titles, class names, ER entity names, anything in a sequence diagram, notes. 7. `flowchart.wrappingWidth` and other author configuration are not supported; the width is fixed. 8. `wrapLabel(label, measureText, wrapWidth)` in `packages/core/src/label/` owns the rules; each layout adapter decides which labels wrap and at what width. ## Consequences - Long-labelled nodes become narrower and taller, and dagre layouts change. - With the canvas measurer, garden-network's wrapped nodes break into the same lines as Mermaid's. - The default test measurer is 8px per character, so line counts in tests differ from Chrome's; the parity report (canvas measurer) is the reference for what a reader sees, and prints per-node sizes. - A wrapped box is wider than the wrap width by the measurer's padding: 16px by default, 24px in the board.
